sentences.text:
Author: C.Praveen Kumar
Bench: C.Praveen Kumar
 The Honourable Sri Justice C.Praveen Kumar
 Criminal Petition No.5941 of 2019
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners/A-1 to A-4 under Section 482 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 to quash the proceedings in F.I.R.No.166 of 2019 on the file of Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District.

entities.text: Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The offences alleged are under Sections 188, 270, 273, 328 and 420 I.P.C. and Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners so also the learned Public Prosecutor submits that the issue involved in the present case is squarely covered by the common order, dated 18.12.2019, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch.
He placed on record copy of the said order.

4. Since the issue involved in the present case is identical to the common order passed in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch, following the said order and in terms thereof, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners/A-1 to A-4 in F.I.R.No.166 of 2019 on the file of Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District are hereby quashed.
5. Registry shall enclose a copy of the common order, dated 18.12.2019, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch to this order.
Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
_______________________________ JUSTICE C.PRAVEEN KUMAR Date : 31.12.2019 AMD THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE C.PRAVEEN KUMAR CRIMINAL PETITION No.5941 of 2019 Date : 31.12.2019 AMD Ravi Pulibujji vs State Of Ap on 31 December, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36607800/
